name: 22-convert-claude-prompt-exclude-prefixes
description: convertClaudePrompt with `excludePrefixes` on. Every turn but the last has its role overwritten with 'system' (:132-134), which is also what eats the 'FixHumMsg' branch -- that branch is guarded on `!excludePrefixes`. The examples keep their names, and an *unrecognised* system name falls through to the `excludePrefixes && v.name` arm of the prefix table, so it is emitted as `\n\n<name>: `; the two reserved names 'example_assistant' and 'example_user' are matched first and become 'A:' / 'H:' (:178). Because none of these turns is the last, all four are 'system' and the name-before-content prefix at :182 is suppressed for them.
